caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing female figure mounted on a rectangular wooden base. The figure is dressed in a green dress with yellow trim at the collar and hem, and a blue sash draped over one shoulder and around the back. Her arms and legs are exposed and painted in a reddish-brown color. The figure wears matching green shoes with yellow trim. She has long dark hair and is adorned with a yellow band around her head, from which extend several large feathers in red, blue, and light brown. The woman holds a rectangular green box or object in her left hand, while her right arm is bent at the elbow, with the hand resting against her chest. The background of the image is a plain, light, off-white color, with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Wooden Pocahontas Store Figure
